intro.label: The portfolio
paragraphs: Each company in N S Lootah Group combines specialised expertise with an independent commercial focus. Together they form a diverse portfolio, built on the Group’s legacy and held to the same standards.
As the portfolio expands, the Group continues to pursue new opportunities while supporting local industries and the UAE economy.
